IVF fees and budget planning

Separate retrieval and culture, medication, laboratory procedures, transfer, storage and travel costs before comparing quotations.

Build a budgetCompare pathwaysDetails and sources

Amounts are planning inputs used by this website. A current fee schedule confirmed by the receiving clinic has not been obtained; these are not provider price commitments.

Build your reference budget

The initial selection is one example combination. Uncheck items you do not need; a clinician determines whether ICSI or PGT-A is appropriate.

$26,100–31,100

IVF retrieval and culture + Stimulation medication + Retrieval anaesthesia + ICSI + Embryo freezing + Frozen embryo transfer (FET)

Excluded: initial tests, transfer medication, travel, accommodation, extra cycles, complications and unselected items.

ICSI and PGT-A are not required for everyone. A cycle does not guarantee a transferable embryo or pregnancy.

What does the base budget include?

Compare the same scope. ICSI is a laboratory step within IVF, so its fee is not comparable to the cost of a complete cycle.

What does the base budget include?
Treatment / base budget (USD)Base scopeAdditional / excludedDetails
IVF — in vitro fertilisation$15,000Routine monitoring, one retrieval, conventional fertilisation and embryo culture.Initial tests, stimulation medication, anaesthesia, ICSI, freezing, annual storage, genetic testing, transfer and living expenses.Details
ICSI — intracytoplasmic sperm injection$1,800The ICSI laboratory procedure, listed separately.The full IVF cycle, medication, anaesthesia, retrieval, culture, storage and transfer.Details
Egg freezing and fertility preservation$9,000Routine monitoring, one retrieval and freezing.Initial tests, medication, anaesthesia and annual storage. Future thawing, fertilisation, culture and transfer are separately assessed and charged.Details
FET — frozen embryo transfer$4,500Routine monitoring, thawing and one transfer.Transfer medication, annual storage, sample transport, additional tests and other procedures.Details

Build a combined budgetCheck service responsibilities

Budget basis and written quotations

With your individual plan, check tests, medication, laboratory work, storage, transfer and living costs, together with the payment recipient and cancellation terms.

Before payment

Request the currency, included procedures and number of services, additional items, payment recipient, payment stages and cancellation or postponement terms in writing.

Costs outside the calculator

Initial tests, transfer medication, transport, accommodation, extra cycles, complication management and unselected items are excluded. Donor and third-party services need separate scope and contracts.
